about: How Sonic earns rings. Pickups are the real Frontiers ring (CommonObject.pac cmn_obj_ring.model) placed on BeamNG's ground; the other rules reward running like Sonic. Each row becomes one RingRuleRow (C++) and one entry of SHEETS.rings (Lua).

columns.trigger: pickup = run through a ring, drift = hard boosted turn, air = airtime on landing, boost = starting a boost
columns.everySeconds: drift: reward period; air: minimum airtime; pickup/boost: 0
columns.rings: rings added each time (air: per second of airtime)
columns.cooldownSeconds: minimum time before the rule pays again
columns.popup: how many Frontiers rings burst around Sonic when it pays
